source.title: Basal ganglia subcircuits distinctively encode the parsing and concatenation of action sequences.

confidence_rationale: High-quality in vivo basal-ganglia recordings (Costa lab, Nat Neurosci) showing two dissociable population signals that map directly onto REE's commit latch: (a) start/stop neurons that bracket a committed sequence (the commit-entry and commit-release boundaries -- SD-034's done-token / MECH-090's gate-open events) and (b) sustained/inhibited neurons whose activity persists across the WHOLE sequence and covaries with execution rate (the maintenance signal -- MECH-090 hold, MECH-342 maintenance). Mapping is functional, not mechanistic; rodent operant sequence onto an ANN routing variable. The 2010 Jin & Costa nigrostriatal start/stop paper is the same lineage and is cited in-text.
failure_signatures: Start/stop and sustained signals emerge through sequence LEARNING; they are not a fixed gate. A REE latch with a pre-set refractory parameter does not reproduce the learned, action-specific emergence of these boundaries.

Direct and indirect pathways are concomitantly active at sequence initiation but diverge during execution -- a two-pathway structure REE collapses into a single commitment-gated routing variable. The duration of the sustained signal is set by execution/behavioural state, not by a standalone timer.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In mice learning rapid action sequences, basal-ganglia neurons signal the start and stop of an entire sequence (parsing), while a separate population shows sustained or inhibited activity throughout sequence execution (concatenation) that covaries with the rate of execution of the individual elements; these signals emerge with learning and are action-specific.
mapping.ree_translation: The start/stop signals are the biological form of REE's commit-entry and commit-release boundary events -- the MECH-090 gate opening at completion and the SD-034 done-token that releases the latch. The sustained-throughout-the-sequence population is the maintenance signal MECH-090 implements as a commitment-gated routing variable held across a committed run, and that MECH-342 modulates with mid-commitment readiness.
mapping.mapping_caveat: These are rodent nigrostriatal/pallidal recordings during learned operant sequences; REE's latch is a single ANN routing variable, not a two-pathway striatal circuit. The biological sustained signal's duration is set by behaviour/execution rate (it covaries with how fast elements are produced), NOT by a standalone refractory timer -- which is the exact divergence the BG-3 node flags. Treat as a functional analogy for the maintenance/boundary STRUCTURE, not for the duration-setting MECHANISM.
mapping.source_context: In vivo electrophysiology, mice, self-paced operant lever-press sequence task; direct/indirect pathway identification.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (Nat Neurosci, Costa lab, clean in vivo dissociation, replicated lineage with Jin & Costa 2010 Nature). Mapping fidelity moderate: the start/stop + sustained STRUCTURE maps cleanly, but REE collapses two pathways into one variable and the sustained signal's duration is behaviour-set not timer-set. Transfer risk moderate: rodent learned operant onto ANN commit latch.
